subject: Next steps & TDX scheduling – Redwood x MeldTech
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Alexandra Ortiz <a.ortiz@meldtech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & TDX scheduling – Redwood x MeldTech

Thanks for the call today, Alexandra — really helpful to hear the infra constraints and the performance targets. Quick recap so we’re aligned:

- Primary goals: reduce inference latency for short-lived sessions (<=150ms p50), support private VPC deployment for PHI workloads, and predictable cost per 1M tokens.
- Key stakeholders you mentioned: Platform lead (you), Security reviewer, and a Product/ML owner to validate model-quality tradeoffs.
- Success criteria for the trial: consistent <200ms p50 at 10 RPS, privacy controls, and onboarding within 2–3 weeks.

The next best step is a 60–90 minute technical deep dive (TDX) with our ML/Infra engineers + your platform/security folks so we can walk the architecture, config levers (batching, quantization, KV caching), and sample load tests. Proposed slots (PT):

1) Tue Aug 10 — 10:00–11:30
2) Thu Aug 12 — 09:00–10:30
3) Mon Aug 16 — 13:00–14:30

Please let me know which of those works (or paste 2–3 alternatives) and who from your side will attend. Recommended Redwood attendees: Ben Carter (serving runtime/quant), Marissa Cole (solutions + runbook), and me (SE lead).

I attached a short preliminary agenda and the discovery recap for your team to skim. If Security wants a separate pre-call to go over SOC2 evidence, we can schedule that as well — just flag procurement@meldtech.com and we’ll loop in our compliance lead.

Next steps: confirm slot + attendee list. I’ll send a calendar invite with pre-reads and a short checklist for access (test dataset, example prompt distributions, expected sequence lengths).

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
attachments: TDX_Agenda_v1.pdf, MeldTech_Discovery_Recap.pdf
